description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10), after #1923 (a kv-slice in scalar context is
its LAST value) fixed 3 of the two files' rows.

WHAT IS LEFT, read off the row descriptions:
  * "correct hash" / "correct array" -- the round trip `%h = %h{keys %h}`.
  * `delete %h{...}` -- the kv form of delete returns the key/value pairs it
    removed.
  * a kv-slice whose base is a REFERENCE (`%$hr{...}` / `$hr->%{...}`) in the
    rows the s473t1 #1024 fix did not reach.
  * the "hash reference is error" / "hash slice reference is error" rows, which
    are NS:Error compatibility for invalid Perl input and stay.

#1440 owns the KEY half of the array form (perl echoes the index EXPRESSION,
`%a[-1]` keying -1 and `%a[1.7]` keying 1.7, where p-kv-aslice reports the
normalised integer).

Guard file: Pl/t/kvaslice-01.t (18 rows as of s473t6c).
subject: The kv-slice residue after #1923: delete %h{...}, a kv-slice of a REFERENCE, and the round-trip rows (op/kvhslice.t 14, op/kvaslice.t 10)
